mapper.sql: SELECT s.story_id, s.title, s.cover, s.setting_content, s.user_id, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.comment_count, s.branch_count, s.participant_count, s.heat_score, s.status, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, u.nick_name AS author_nick_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.title SEPARATOR ',') FROM zhw_story_topic st2 JOIN zhw_topic t ON t.topic_id = st2.topic_id AND t.del_flag = '0' WHERE st2.story_id = s.story_id) AS topic_names FROM zhw_story s LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0'
mapper.select:
SELECT q.*, IF(#{currentUserId} > 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_like l WHERE l.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND l.target_id = q.story_id AND l.target_type = 0), 0) AS liked, IF(#{currentUserId} > 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_mark m WHERE m.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND m.story_id = q.story_id AND m.branch_id = 0), 0) AS marked FROM (
AND s.story_id = #{storyId} ) q

SELECT q.*, IF(#{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND #{currentUserId} > 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_like l WHERE l.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND l.target_id = q.story_id AND l.target_type = 0), 0) AS liked, IF(#{currentUserId} IS NOT NULL AND #{currentUserId} > 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_mark m WHERE m.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND m.story_id = q.story_id AND m.branch_id = 0), 0) AS marked FROM (
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zhw_story_topic st WHERE st.story_id = s.story_id AND st.topic_id = #{topicId})
) q
ORDER BY q.heat_score DESC
ORDER BY RAND()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zhw_story (title, cover, setting_content, user_id, view_count, like_count, comment_count, branch_count, participant_count, heat_score, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{cover}, #{settingContent}, #{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, '0', '0', #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE zhw_story SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
UPDATE zhw_story SET like_count = like_count + #{delta} WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
UPDATE zhw_story SET comment_count = comment_count + #{delta} WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
UPDATE zhw_story SET branch_count = branch_count + #{delta} WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
UPDATE zhw_story s SET participant_count = ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.user_id) FROM zhw_branch b WHERE b.story_id = #{storyId} AND b.del_flag = '0' ) WHERE s.story_id = #{storyId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_story WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status = '0'

SELECT s.story_id, s.title, s.cover, s.setting_content, s.user_id, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.comment_count, s.branch_count, s.participant_count, s.heat_score, s.status, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, u.nick_name AS author_nick_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, IF(#{currentUserId} > 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_like l WHERE l.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND l.target_id = s.story_id AND l.target_type = 0), 0) AS liked, IF(#{currentUserId} > 0, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_mark m WHERE m.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND m.story_id = s.story_id AND m.branch_id = 0), 0) AS marked FROM zhw_story s LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE zhw_story SET is_collected = #{collected}, update_time = NOW() WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.story_id, s.title, s.cover, s.setting_content, s.user_id, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.comment_count, s.branch_count, s.participant_count, s.heat_score, s.status, s.del_flag, s.is_collected, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, u.nick_name AS author_nick_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM zhw_story s LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.is_collected = 1 ORDER BY s.branch_count DESC, s.heat_score DESC

SELECT s.story_id, s.title, s.cover, s.setting_content, s.user_id, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.comment_count, s.branch_count, s.participant_count, s.heat_score, s.status, s.del_flag, s.is_collected, s.create_by, s.create_time, u.nick_name AS author_nick_name FROM zhw_story s LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' AND s.branch_count >= #{minBranches} ORDER BY s.branch_count DESC, s.heat_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.story_id, s.title, s.cover, s.setting_content, s.user_id, s.view_count, s.like_count, s.comment_count, s.branch_count, s.participant_count, s.heat_score, s.status, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, u.nick_name AS author_nick_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM zhw_story s LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0'
AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND s.status = #{status}
ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE zhw_story SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
UPDATE zhw_story SET del_flag = '2', update_time = NOW() WHERE story_id = #{storyId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_story WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND status = #{status}
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM zhw_story WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_story WHERE del_flag = '0') AS totalStories, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_story WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '0') AS activeStories, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_branch WHERE del_flag = '0') AS totalBranches, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_comment WHERE del_flag = '0') AS totalComments, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_user WHERE status = '0') AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_story WHERE del_flag = '0' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayNewStories, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_branch WHERE del_flag = '0' AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayNewBranches FROM DUAL
